name: relationship-review
title: Mentoring relationship review
for_each: select id,code from matches order by code

sections.title: Goals and evidence
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due,status,evidence from goals where match_id=$1 order by due

sections.title: Sessions
sections.sql: select held_on,status,topic,feedback from sessions where match_id=$1 order by held_on

name: programme-review
title: Mentoring programme review
for_each: select id,code from programmes order by code

sections.title: Purpose and owner
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,purpose,review_due from programmes where id=$1

sections.title: Pair health
sections.sql: select h.code,h.mentor,h.mentee,h.health,h.completed_sessions from pair_health h join matches m on m.id=h.id where m.programme_id=$1 order by h.code

sections.title: Outstanding development
sections.sql: select g.code,g.title,g.owner,g.due from goals g join matches m on m.id=g.match_id where m.programme_id=$1 and g.status='open' order by g.due
